faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is GovConnect an official government website?
faq.a1: No. GovConnect is an independent citizen-assistance platform. We help you discover and navigate government services but you must complete all official processes on the respective government portals.
faq.a2: GovConnect is designed with a privacy-first architecture. Your profile data is used only to generate personalised recommendations within the platform.
faq.q3: Can GovConnect submit applications on my behalf?
faq.a3: No. GovConnect helps you prepare and understand requirements. All applications, including CAPTCHA, OTP verification, and final submission, must be completed by you on the official government portal.
faq.a4: Yes. You can switch between English and Hindi using the language selector in the navigation bar.
faq.a5: Yes, GovConnect is completely free for all citizens.
faq.q6: How does the AI grievance assistant work?
faq.a6: You describe your issue, our AI classifies it, identifies the relevant department, and generates a formal complaint draft. You then visit the official portal to submit it yourself.
